hypotheses.name: Local witness-cycle persistence on H70 hotspots
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung with seeds 42/43/44, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {7,11}, computed local edge-centered cycle-persistence surrogates on kNN geodesic neighborhoods and added them to H70-style defect scores; evaluated against matched-random hotspot-set, feature-shuffle, and label-shuffle nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.01595; positive mean domain-splits=6/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=4/6
hypotheses.next_action: Run a confirmatory pass with explicit endpoint-swap null and alternate hotspot thresholding to test robustness of the 4/6 null-gap gate.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model pathway trajectory invariance
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot on immune/lung/external_lung with scGPT layers {0,3,7,11} and Geneformer token-rank quartile strata; built TRRUST+GO pathway modules, compared depth-wise module-distance trajectories via mean pairwise Spearman, and tested module-label, depth-order, and signature-destroy nulls.
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this variant; only reopen cross-model work with a materially different anchoring regime and pre-registered null-gap gate.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Cross-model trajectory concordance remained below null-q95 in all tested domains.

hypotheses.name: Shortcut-bridge competition index broad screen
hypotheses.method: Seed42 breadth screen across immune/lung/external_lung, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {0,3,7,11}; combined node bridge proxy and triangle-closing fraction into an SBC index and added it to directed-geodesic baseline; tested endpoint-swap, feature-shuffle, and label-shuffle nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=-0.02803; positive mean domain-splits=0/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire SBC as a standalone additive score; if revisited, test only as a conditional modifier within an already-positive geometry channel.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Uniformly negative deltas and null-gaps across all domain-splits in this broad screen.
